subCategories.label: Cheesy
playerOptions: Are you redstone? You power my day.
I burned bread again; the wheat was offended.

npcResponses: You got a laugh out of me.

subCategories.label: Dark
playerOptions: At least only my plans exploded today.
The void might start charging me rent.

subCategories.label: Self-Deprecating
playerOptions: I got lost in my own house.
I missed a zombie at point-blank range.

npcResponses: We've all had days like that.
At least you can laugh about it.

subCategories.label: Meta
playerOptions: Feels like someone is clicking our dialogue options.
Do you feel like this world is code sometimes?

npcResponses: You think too much, but I like it.
